result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but one clear rendering bug exists: overlapping metadata text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card. A few other layout/styling inconsistencies (clipped carousel card, mismatched favorite button styling, content clipped by the bottom nav) also degrade the visual quality.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery-time and delivery-fee texts are drawn on top of each other ('25–35 min' overlapping '€0 delivery'), producing unreadable garbled text.
issues.suggestion: Lay the meta row out as a single flex row with a separator/gap instead of absolutely positioning or stacking the two labels; ensure text is not duplicated or overlapping.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off abruptly by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its title, rating and badges with no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll container equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all cards, using a single overlay treatment for legibility on any image.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you' the third card and its title ('Trattoria Piccol…') are clipped at the screen edge without truncation ellipsis, and the category chip row is likewise cut mid-chip.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal peek/padding to the carousel and apply text-overflow ellipsis to card titles so partially visible items read as intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text labels, which may leave them unlabeled for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites') for all icon-only buttons.
